text_block_list.text:
Cesario hadn't shown up for training, so 
while searching all over for her—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"You're still acting with the intention of 
making them laugh. Remember, the 
characters are simply doing their best, 
thinking seriously, and living true to 
themselves."

text_block_list.name: Drama Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a theater lover, you've got 
a discerning eye. Sorry for taking up so 
much of your time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list:
So focused on your passionate coaching you 
didn't even notice your ringtone... Good 
work out there

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she was so absorbed in her 
favorite plays that she lost track of 
time. I urged her to seriously reflect on 
it so it won't happen again.
